stages.title: Mathematics, Autograd & Language Modeling
stages.goal: Master NTP loss and numerical optimization with CPU-verifiable baselines.

stages.title: Transformer Architecture
stages.goal: Build and verify a modern decoder-only GPT with position encoding and KV-cached decode.

stages.title: Pretraining & Scaling
stages.goal: Run controlled NTP training and analyze the model–data–compute tradeoff.

stages.title: SFT, PEFT & Preference Optimization
stages.goal: Compare SFT, LoRA/QLoRA and DPO on a fixed held-out instruction set.

stages.title: Mechanistic Interpretability
stages.goal: Study internal mechanisms with controlled probes, circuits and SAE experiments.

stages.title: Reasoning, Search & Reinforcement Learning
stages.goal: Evaluate test-time search and a small verifiable-reward policy optimization loop.

stages.title: Inference Optimization & Serving
stages.goal: Implement correctness-first kernels, cache analysis and reproducible online serving benchmarks.

stages.title: Distributed Training & Frontier Architecture
stages.goal: Reason about DP/TP/PP/EP memory, routing and collective communication tradeoffs.
